name: NQ PM late-session VWAP 2.5-sigma rejection fade (VWR) — high-winrate study
registered: 2026-10-05, after IS/VAL analysis only; 2025 not yet evaluated for this family

rules.band: RTH VWAP +/- 2.5 x volume-weighted stdev of typical price since 09:30
rules.trigger: first 2m bar of the day (edge-triggered) whose high >= upper band but close < upper band -> SHORT; mirror for lower band -> LONG
rules.entry: market at the open of the next 1m bar
rules.stop: rejection-bar extreme +/- 1 tick (structural); trade skipped if stop < 0.5 ATR or > 4 ATR (2m ATR14)

note: IS/VAL expectancy already below +0.35R; OOS run is documentation of robustness/tail risk, not a candidate for the hard requirement
